title: Subexponential Bohnenblust-Hille Inequalities on Finite Cyclic Groups
summary: Let $C_q$ denote the group of the $q$th roots of unity. A question arising from the work of Becker, Klein, Slote, Volberg and Zhang is whether the dimension-free Bohnenblust--Hille constants for functions on $C_q^N$ grow subexponentially with the degree. We answer this question affirmatively. In fact, we prove a stronger estimate for functions whose Fourier characters involve at most $d$ coordinates.
